resources.string: Connecting to nearby phones over Bluetooth

When your phone has no signal (a blackout, an earthquake, a typhoon, an overloaded cell tower, in the mountains or on a plane), openchat links nearby phones over Bluetooth and passes each message from phone to phone.
No sign-up, no phone number, no server.
Next, you\'ll be asked to allow Bluetooth so the app can find people nearby.

· The Nearby channel is public. Everyone in range can see it.
· Private messages are encrypted, but people nearby can tell you use this app and can recognize the same phone over time.
· This app has not had a full independent security audit. If being identified would put you in serious danger, don't rely on it.
· Tap the title at the top three times to erase all data at once.
Erased. You now have a new identity: %1$s
